remarks:
Step back in time and discover the charm of the former Bissell Home at 3981 Route 394 in Randolph, New York. Once connected to a historic lumberyard, this property proudly showcases the kind of solid craftsmanship and beautiful original woodwork that is hard to find today. Rich in character and history, the home offers warm architectural details, spacious living areas, and the timeless appeal of a bygone era built to last. With a first floor primary suite with a huge walk-in closet. This space would also make a great home office with a separate entrance. Off the formal living room is a den with half bath.  Upstairs are four bedrooms all with closets and a full bath.  

Outside, you’ll find plenty of room to roam and enjoy the peaceful setting, complete with a creek flowing along the backyard — creating the perfect backdrop for relaxing evenings, outdoor gatherings, or simply enjoying nature. Whether you are looking for a full-time residence, country retreat, or a property with historic charm, this home offers endless possibilities.

Conveniently located in Western New York’s recreation corridor, this property is approximately 25 minutes from Holiday Valley for skiing, golf, mountain biking, and year-round entertainment, approximately 30 minutes from Allegany State Park with over 65,000 acres of hiking, camping, and outdoor adventure, and about 35 minutes from Chautauqua Institution, known for its nationally recognized arts, music, and cultural experiences.

This is your opportunity to own a piece of Randolph history while enjoying all the beauty and recreation the Chautauqua-Allegheny region has to offer.
